method: Each row is the first walking route listed by Google Maps directions (travelmode=walking) for the origin hotel address to the destination address, read with the page reader on 2026-11-17. Google's route list shows the walking duration and distance for each alternative; the first (fastest) alternative is recorded. Google's default departure text on the page is 'Mon, Nov 16', so the figure is a walking-route estimate from Google, not a time-of-day measurement; walking routes are not traffic-dependent. Addresses are the official street addresses used in data/site/walking.json, not re-verified against each property page in this pass.
